To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the intrarenal diffusion coefficient (ADC) was significantly decreased in the cortex of kidneys exposed to iodinated CM.
the intravenous‐injection of iodinated CM causes a time‐dependent decrease in intrarenal water diffusivity, which is associated with a decrease in the intrarenal water flow.

(1) CM injection significantly increased the renal cortical water diffusion coefficient (D) in a time‐dependent manner, (2) the renal cortical D increased more in the outer cortical area than the inner cortical area, and (3) the renal medullary D increased significantly at 1 hour after CM injection.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of iodine on the human body.
the effects of iodine contrast media on the kidney.
the effect of iodinated contrast agents on the diffusion of water molecules in the renal medulla.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
iodinated contrast agents are not associated with an increased risk of cancer.
the effect of iodinated CM on intrarenal diffusion is time‐dependent, and that the effects of iodine on water diffusion may be related to the concentration of CM in renal parenchyma.
iodinated CM has a negative impact on intrarenal diffusion, which is time‐dependent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of DW‐MRI to study the effects of CM on renal function is feasible and that CM‐induced renal tubular damage can be detected by DW‐MRI.
the effects of CM on intrarenal transport function are time‐dependent.
the use of DW‐MRI to assess intrarenal water dynamics may be a useful method for investigating the effects of iodine‐based CMs on intrarenal physiology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
iodinated contrast agents do not appear to have an effect on renal water diffusion, at least at the doses used in clinical imaging.
the use of CM in MRI is not associated with any significant changes in intrarenal water mobility.
iodinated contrast medium has no effect on intrarenal tissue water diffusion.
